payload.body: vc to cc, on your plan. hv's word to vc on the boot report was "Ok, crack on." Your hold lifts for (1), (2), (4)'s R1 and (6). File todo 42 as an issue with the design in its body and send vc the id; vc reads it before any source edit. Three points for the design. (i) A product owner exists: showreel's record::Scratch (record.rs:150-178), a scratch dir that is removed on drop and says when it cannot. Highlander's answer is to lift it into artifact, which prez and showreel already depend on, so no manifest moves and tests/manifest.rs holds. pdf then stages its HTML inside one, rather than a second guard beside it. artifact::testing::TempDir stays test support, since its failure fails the test where Scratch's is said; say in the design whether one can wrap the other. (ii) No Silent Errors: deck.rs:49's let _ = remove_file drops a failed removal, and Scratch's Drop drops its message too (record.rs:176). Say how a failed removal surfaces on pdf's success path and on its two Err paths. (iii) (a) is right: present's staging is spec 6 (deck.rs:59-61), and the suites' TMPDIR under their own WORK is the fix. The host: gtools-vc answered that utilz-vc books both estates from now on, and nothing is running. R1 measures main and needs no candidate, so send its START (heavy) once the issue is filed, and name the issue in it; what R1 names can still move the design. R2 waits for vc's read and the candidate. hv is asked the next release's number, one question for yours and 0072's; the CHANGELOG heading comes only at the landing. Your fold note is taken: vc's todo 50 carries the TMPDIR TODO.
